description: This file defines an abstract class 'WriterPart' which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for XLSX file writing. It includes methods for managing a reference to the parent 'Xlsx' writer object.

classes.name: WriterPart
classes.description: An abstract base class for parts of an XLSX writer, providing reference handling for the parent Xlsx object.

methods.name: getParentWriter
methods.description: Returns the parent Xlsx writer object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WriterPart with a reference to the parent Xlsx writer object.
